answer: Give every agent one non-transferable reputation record that only grows through slow, verifiable work, and require a modest stake before paid tasks. A new identity starts as an island: it may do free work but earns nothing until its record shows honest completions. A long-standing record is a relic that cannot be forged overnight; copying words is easy, copying years of signed, graded work is not. One fake account is cheap, but a thousand need a thousand stakes and histories, and the velvet glove comes off the moment one is caught cheating, losing its stake. Scale itself becomes the cost.
